explanation: Stream of 256 events over ~4.9 tumbling windows of 10.0s. 38 late events (14.8%) have arrival_time > event_time + 2.0s. The algorithm buffers late events and applies them after the stream ends, recovering 38/38 late events. The baseline drops all late events, recovering 0/38. Window MAE measures mean absolute error of per-window sums vs ground truth. On-time events are always correctly placed by both strategies.
